basis.title: FishBack: Pullback Fisher Geometry for Optimal Activation Steering in Transformers
basis.use: Existing local quadratic Fisher-cost comparator; this study retains its small-perturbation interpretation and tests a finite signed logit forecast.

basis.title: Transformer Field Theory: A Response-Theoretic Approach to Mechanistic Interpretability
basis.use: Local directional response framing and explicit validity checks; no claim of a new universal field law.

equations: Standard second-order directional Taylor expansion of logits followed by exact softmax; standard first/second derivative chain rules and log-partition/Bregman expansion.
prior_evidence: Study12 failed output-cost primary and its separately labeled exploratory eight-case hand-off diagnostic remain unchanged.
